request: Write a polite professional business email from a student to a professor regarding requesting a deadline extension, specifically because the project needs two more days. Do not invent additional reasons.
before: - Send an e-mail with your request for extensions and deadlines (e.g., "I'm looking forward to working on this next semester.") - Include in your resume or CV any information about yourself that you think will help make it easier for students to get their work done at home!
after: Subject [Name]: Dear Professor, I am writing this letter in response of your recent request for an extended period of time (please refer to my previous e-mail address).  I understand that you have been experiencing some serious issues with our research and we are currently working on resolving these problems through collaboration between us. Please be aware that it is important to note that due process may apply if necessary - please contact me immediately or call 1‑800‐822–9000 . We appreciate any assistance!
note: Qualitative example only; no manual quality score assigned.
